description: THE REFUSAL of the delete of an ENTITY with consumers: Contact is the source of the aggregate of Contact_CountActive (the filter cites it and the output of the aggregate is the type `Contact Record List`, made of the anonymous record `Contact Record` that the platform maintains). Without force the delete is refused AND the message names the aggregate: the filter is inside it and is not repeated, and the anonymous record in use points to whoever uses it. The anonymous record and the type `Contact List` alone no longer refuse (tested coverage, phase 2): an entity without author consumers is deleted without force (tests/jobs/delete-generated-companions.json).
